chunks: Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who, out of ignorance, did not shorten his hair or shave it until he departed from Mina. He said: "Then let him return to Mina so that he may cast his hair there, whether by shaving or shortening. And for the one performing hajj for the first time, shaving is required."
And it is narrated: "He may shave in Mecca and carry his hair to Mina."

key_terms.الصَّرُورَةِ: the one performing hajj for the first time
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the hajj location where this rite is to be completed
key_terms.يَحْلِقَهُ: to shave the hair as part of the ritual
key_terms.يُقَصِّرَ: to shorten the hair as part of the hajj rite

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if he forgot or did not know to shave or shorten his hair before leaving Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who leaves Mina without shaving or shortening the hair due to ignorance. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that the act should be completed in connection with Mina, and it also states that for a first-time pilgrim, shaving is the prescribed form. A further report allows shaving in Mecca while taking the hair to Mina.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3093 - Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who, out of ignorance, failed to shorten or shave his hair before leaving Mina.
Imam (as) said: "He should return to Mina and discard his hair there, whether by shaving or shortening. For someone performing Hajj for the first time, shaving is obligatory."
It is also narrated: "He may shave in Mecca and carry his hair to Mina."
